title: Acme Outfitters calculation-group items by month and year, and the two roles (static Region West; dynamic Store Manager for one user)

cases.query:
EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE(
    SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Date'[Year], 'Time Calc'[Time Calculation], "v", [Total Sales]),
    NOT ('Orders'[Status] IN {"Cancelled"})
)

EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE(
    SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Date'[Year], 'Time Calc'[Time Calculation], "v", [Order Count]),
    NOT ('Orders'[Status] IN {"Cancelled"})
)

EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE(
    SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Date'[Year], 'Time Calc'[Time Calculation], "v", [Margin %]),
    NOT ('Orders'[Status] IN {"Cancelled"})
)

EVALUATE CALCULATETABLE(
    SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Date'[Year], 'Time Calc'[Time Calculation], "v", [Units Sold]),
    NOT ('Orders'[Status] IN {"Cancelled"})
)
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Date'[Year Month], 'Time Calc'[Time Calculation], "v", [Total Sales])
EVALUATE 'Time Calc'

EVALUATE ROW("Orders", COUNTROWS('Orders'), "Customers", COUNTROWS('Customers'), "Products", COUNTROWS('Products'), "Stores", COUNTROWS('Stores'), "Targets", COUNTROWS('Targets'), "Returns", COUNTROWS('Returns'), "Web Sessions", COUNTROWS('Web Sessions'), "Date", COUNTROWS('Date'), "Time Calc", COUNTROWS('Time Calc'), "Products Never Sold", COUNTROWS('Products Never Sold'), "Last Refreshed", COUNTROWS('Last Refreshed'))
EVALUATE ROW("Total Sales", [Total Sales], "Order Count", [Order Count], "Target", [Target], "Returns Count", [Returns Count], "Sessions", [Sessions], "Customer Count", [Customer Count])
EVALUATE SUMMARIZECOLUMNS('Stores'[Store Name], "Total Sales", [Total Sales], "Target", [Target])
